detailed_description:
The target video is a living painterly illustration in <Subject 1>: brushstroke texture stays visible as everything moves, motion is slow, gentle and dreamlike.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The pink and gold sky deepens to night and the first stars appear, mirrored on the still water among the lily pads, while the fireflies drift slowly upward. The camera pushes forward and down at a slow, steady speed in one continuous move toward the reflection of the stars on the surface, the reflected night sky growing until it fills the frame, and it passes gently through the mirror-like water into deep space. The lily pads keep floating around the camera, now drifting among the stars like small green planets, a glowing nebula opens in emerald, gold and violet, and a white water lily shines at the center like a bright star, soft rings of light spreading out from it as if space were still water. The camera is still drifting forward as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
